title: Prefix Sum
definition: An array `P` where `P[i]` is the sum of all elements from index `0` to `i`. It allows calculating the sum of any subarray `[L, R]` in O(1) time using the formula `P[R] - P[L-1]`.
simpleExplanation: Pre-calculating a running total so that if someone asks 'what is the sum from day 5 to day 10', you just take 'Total at day 10' minus 'Total at day 4'.
